hints.content: Losing value at a rate of $30\%$ per year means the computer keeps $100\%-30\%=70\%$ of its value each year.
So each year, the value is multiplied by $70\%$, which is the same as a factor of $0.7$.

If we start with the initial value, $\$900$, and keep multiplying by $0.7$, this function gives us the value of the computer $t$ years from now:

$V(t)=900(0.7)^t$

question.content:
A computer sells for $\$900$ and loses $30\%$ of its value per year.

**Write a function that gives the computer's value, $V(t)$,  $t$ years after it is sold.**
